title: Compare plans: choose the layout
question: Nuzzle's dark violet look stays the same on every card. What you're choosing is how the page is laid out. Keep the lead card, pick another one, or re-roll.

options.label: The Coverage Map
options.lineage: A home floor plan seen from above, like a robot vacuum's map
options.thesis: Draw what each option actually covers: a treat-cam's fixed view cone next to NuzzlePal's patrol path through the same flat.
materials: patrol paths in each species' color
options.viewport: A large top-down plan of a one-bedroom flat fills the first screen. Switch between Treat-cam, Cat and Dog above it: the treat-cam lights up one cone, the Cat plan traces perch-height loops, the Dog plan sweeps the floor. Price and a Choose button sit beside the map.
options.risk: If the plan is drawn too literally it reads as an architecture tool, so the linework has to stay light and part of the brand.

raised.raise: Below the map, the comparison grid shows every feature the treat-cam lacks as a ghosted, dashed empty slot, so what's missing is visible instead of an ✕.

options.label: The 2 p.m. Moments
options.lineage: Incident cards from a pet owner's day
options.thesis: Compare through the moments that make owners worry: a thunderstorm, a bark streak, zoomies at 2 a.m. Each shows what a treat-cam does and what NuzzlePal does.
options.viewport: A row of large timestamped cards, each a real pet photo framed like a camera feed. Tap one to flip it from 'Treat-cam: records it' to 'NuzzlePal: responds'. Plans and prices sit in a sticky bar below.
options.risk: Scenario copy can drift into claims, so every response has to match features already on the site.

options.label: Twin Feeds
options.lineage: Two camera monitors side by side
options.thesis: Two feeds of the same afternoon, one passive and one NuzzlePal. As you scroll, both play through the same events and only one of them reacts.
options.viewport: Two monitor frames split the screen. The left is a static wide shot tagged TREAT-CAM, the right uses the hero cam video tagged NUZZLEPAL. A shared timecode runs above, and each feed logs its own events below.
options.risk: Uses the hero video a second time, and scrolling that controls playback needs careful fallbacks on mobile.

options.label: Sticker album spread
options.thesis: Every feature is a numbered slot, and an empty slot shows its ghosted outline.
options.viewport: A grid of numbered slots on an album spread.
options.case: Loses both tests: the paper-and-gloss look would replace Nuzzle's settled identity, and slots hide prices.
options.risk: A costume that fights the dark cosmic world.
options.kept: Empty ghost slots that show what's missing, now in the lead card's grid.

options.label: Brick build instructions
options.thesis: Numbered exploded steps with wordless arrows.
options.viewport: Step numbers building up a plan.
options.case: Loses both tests: comparison isn't assembly, and owners wouldn't recognize themselves in it.
options.kept: One strict spacing grid aligns the map, grid and plan columns.

options.label: Nixie-tube counter
options.case: Loses both tests: a warm orange world clashes with the violet brand, and prices are too few to carry it.
options.kept: Prices change as a single cross-fade when you switch plans, with no count-up.
